auth.label: API Key
auth.placeholder: Paste your Yingmi MCP API Key
auth.description: API Key sent in the x-api-key header. Apply and copy it from https://qieman.com/mcp/account.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current Yingmi MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema and behavior annotations.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current Yingmi MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the Yingmi MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current Yingmi financial data, research, and advisory MCP tools with their live input schemas.

name.description: The exact Yingmi MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by Yingmi MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside Yingmi.

annotations.description: MCP hints supplied by Yingmi about a tool's behavior.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by Yingmi MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected Yingmi MCP account.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed to the connected Yingmi MCP account.

outputSchema.description: The current Yingmi MCP tool catalog.
